material_finding.observed_behavior: The base execution_receipts row and execution_v2_metadata are persisted by separate SQLite writer transactions after external dispatch returns.
material_finding.failure_window: A crash, kill, storage error, or second-write failure after the first commit can leave the base ExecutionReceipt present while its v2 source/status/duplicate metadata is absent.
material_finding.credit_boundary: Completion remains fail-closed when v2 metadata is missing, but recovery and audit exactness do not have an atomic execution-receipt bundle. This is not a runtime PASS or a canonical-semantics result.
